units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 5:1">Maasr. V, 1</cite> <he>חעוקר ש׳ מתוך שלו וכ׳</he> if one takes plants out of his own garden to set them in his own, he is exempt from tithes; <cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 3:8">Tosef. ib. III, 8</cite> <he>שות׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>שת׳</he>).

<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 3:8">Ib.</cite> <he>שְׁתִילִין ועטינין</he> sets or young herbs; Y. ib. V, beg. 51ᶜ <he>עטנין ושתלין</he>. Ib. <he>מה בין חטים מה בין ש׳</he> what is the difference between wheat (used for seed) and sets (with regard to tithes)? <he>חטים גמר מלאכה ש׳ וכ׳</he> wheat is a finished object, sets are not; a. e.
